title: FIELD APPLICATION ENGINEER (FAE – Electronics)
jobDescription:
Position Overview: The Field Application Engineer will serve as a technical interface between Silicon Microsystems and its customers, providing hands-on support during solution design, demonstrations, installation, training and technical troubleshooting. The role involves working closely with academic institutions, research organizations and engineering colleges to support deployment of advanced laboratory infrastructure, Centres of Excellence (Co E), and specialized technology platforms. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
(Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following)
1. Pre-Sales Technical Consultation: Understand customer requirements and propose suitable laboratory infrastructure, Centre of Excellence (Co E) setups, training and technology solutions. Deliver technical presentations, demonstrations and proof-of-concept sessions to highlight the capabilities and benefits of Si MS solutions. Work with the internal technical and sales teams to prepare customized solution proposals and technical documentation. Support solution architecture discussions with institutional leadership and faculty members.
2. Post-Sales Implementation & Technical Support: Provide installation, setup and configuration support for hardware, software and laboratory systems. Conduct technical training programs for faculty members, researchers and students to ensure effective adoption of solutions. Provide ongoing technical assistance, troubleshooting and product updates to maintain high customer satisfaction. Document implementation processes and provide feedback to internal product teams for improvements.
3. Client Engagement & Relationship Building: Build long-term professional relationships with faculty members, researchers, department heads and institutional administrators. Support institutions in integrating Si MS technologies into academic curricula, research activities and skill development programs. Facilitate technical discussions related to Mo Us, joint academic initiatives and collaborative technology programs.
4. Market Expansion & Technical Outreach: Represent Silicon Microsystems at technical seminars, workshops, symposiums and technology exhibitions. Conduct technical workshops, hackathons, faculty development programs and hands-on training sessions for students and faculty members. Travel extensively to support sales engagements, technology deployments and customer support activities across assigned regions. Educational Qualification: Master’s/Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering in Electronics and allied disciplines. Candidates with exposure to sales, marketing or client coordination activities will be preferred. Technical Knowledge: Understanding of Embedded Systems, VLSI concepts, Io T platforms, Robotics, Communication Systems and AI. Hands-on familiarity with development boards, hardware platforms, measurement instruments and commonly used academic engineering tools. Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new technology platforms and laboratory solutions. Application Engineering & Customer Engagement: Interest in technical consulting, solution engineering and client engagement. Ability to translate complex technical solutions into clear and practical value propositions for institutions and customers. Strong problem-solving, troubleshooting and customer support capabilities. Soft Skills & Personal Attributes: Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated, proactive and customer-oriented mindset. Willingness to travel extensively (50% or more) across assigned regions. Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams. Experience: 0 – 2 Years. Prior involvement in college technical clubs, engineering projects, technical fests, hackathons, event organization or competitions will be considered an advantage. Compensation: Annual Cost to Company (CTC) ₹4,20,000 per annum (including performance incentives) The compensation structure includes: Fixed monthly salary components as per company payroll structure. Performance-linked incentives based on sales support, institutional deployments and revenue realization. Reimbursement of approved travel, communication and official expenses as per company policy. Additional Benefits & Support: Approved travel expenses. Company support for field travel logistics and advance tour expenses when required. Exposure to advanced technology platforms and industry-relevant engineering solutions. Probation Period: The selected candidate will undergo a probation period of nine (9) months from the date of joining. Why Join Silicon Microsystems?: Work with a 28-year-old technology leader in electronics, semiconductor and advanced engineering domains. Opportunity to collaborate with leading universities, engineering colleges, research institutions and industry organizations across India. Exposure to cutting-edge technologies including VLSI, Embedded Systems, Robotics, Automation and AI. A dynamic, innovative and growth-oriented work culture with opportunities for continuous professional development. Attractive compensation structure with performance-based incentives and career growth opportunities. Apply: If you are passionate about technology, education and client engagement, we invite you to apply and grow with Silicon Microsystems.

title: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE
jobDescription:
Position Overview: The Business Development Executive will support the company's market outreach, institutional engagement and student-focused marketing initiatives for technology training programs. The role involves interacting with universities, engineering colleges, students, professionals and institutional decision-makers, helping expand Silicon Microsystems' presence in the technical education and skill development ecosystem. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Market Research & Strategy Development: Analyze emerging industry trends in ESDM, VLSI, Embedded Systems, Industrial Automation, Artificial Intelligence and Io T. Identify potential academic institutions, training partners and individual learners for certification programs and skill development initiatives. Support the development and execution of marketing and outreach strategies to promote training courses and technology programs. Conduct competitor analysis and market research to identify new growth opportunities.
2. Engagement with Academic Institutions: Assist in outreach and relationship building with universities, engineering colleges and training institutions. Support organization of presentations, seminars, webinars and campus workshops to showcase Silicon Microsystems' training programs. Engage with students, faculty members and institutional leadership to generate leads and program participation.
3. Promotional & Sales Support: Promote certification programs, training courses and skill development workshops to students, professionals and institutions. Assist in designing and implementing B2B (Institutional) and B2C (Student/Professional) marketing campaigns. Work closely with the business development and sales teams to generate leads, nurture prospects and support program enrollments. Maintain lead databases and assist in follow-up with prospective participants.
4. Event Management & Brand Representation: Support participation in education fairs, skill development expos, technology symposiums and campus engagement events. Assist in planning and execution of hackathons, skill development boot camps, technical workshops and faculty development programs. Represent Silicon Microsystems in academic and industry events when required.
5. Digital Marketing & Content Development: Assist in developing brochures, blogs, whitepapers, newsletters and marketing collaterals to promote training solutions. Support social media campaigns, email marketing initiatives and digital lead-generation strategies. Work with the internal marketing team to enhance online visibility and outreach for training programs.
6. Customer & Partner Engagement: Collect feedback from students, faculty members and academic partners to improve program offerings. Support collaborations with training partners, industry stakeholders and government skill development initiatives. Maintain professional communication with prospective participants and institutional contacts. Educational Qualification: MBA in Marketing, Business Development or related specialization Background in Engineering or Technology domains (preferred but not mandatory) Marketing & Business Development Skills: Strong interest in technical education, skill development and professional training ecosystems. Basic understanding of B2B and B2C marketing strategies. Ability to communicate value propositions effectively to students, faculty and institutional decision-makers. Digital & Content Marketing Skills: Familiarity with social media marketing, digital campaigns and email outreach tools. Ability to assist in developing marketing content and promotional materials. Personal Attributes: Strong communication and interpersonal skills. Self-motivated, proactive and eager to learn. Ability to work in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Willingness to travel for academic outreach and institutional engagements when required. Experience: 0 – 2 Years Fresh MBA graduates with strong communication and marketing interest are encouraged to apply. Prior involvement in college clubs, marketing activities, event management, technical fests, entrepreneurship cells or student leadership roles will be an added advantage. Compensation: Annual Cost to Company (CTC) ₹3,60,000 per annum (including performance-based incentives) The compensation structure includes: Fixed salary components paid monthly as per company payroll policies. Performance-linked incentives based on business development and revenue achievements. Approved travel and communication expense reimbursements as per company policies. Probation Period: The selected candidate will undergo a probation period of nine (9) months from the date of joining. Why Join Silicon Microsystems?: Gain hands-on experience in technical marketing, skill development and education technology initiatives. Opportunity to interact with industry experts, academic leaders and aspiring engineers across India. Work in a technology-driven environment at the intersection of education and innovation. Build practical experience in business development, marketing strategy and institutional partnerships. Attractive incentive structure for high-performing individuals. Apply: If you are passionate about technical education, skill development and professional training, we invite you to apply and grow with Silicon Microsystems.
